purpose: City-specific registry/map source review and bounded safe route inspection for the WUP ranked settlement point.
primaryPublisher: Kerala Department of Survey and Land Records; Kerala Land Records Modernization Mission
registryBasis: Official Kerala Survey & Land Records page lists Kottayam district survey, re-survey, mapping and digitization offices; the Kerala BhuNaksha portal advertises cadastral map selectors. This establishes local survey/registry infrastructure, but not exact WUP-point parcel coverage or an accessible vector route.

officialSources.observation: Official Kerala Survey and Land Records office directory lists multiple survey/mapping/re-survey offices and a District Digitization Centre in Kottayam district.

Official Kerala BhuNaksha portal search listing identifies Revenue, Survey and Registration Department and exposes Block No., Survey No., Sub Division No. and Plot Info UI; direct shell HTTPS validation failed because the certificate was expired, and was not bypassed.
Official Ente Bhoomi page provides a land-information form with district/taluk/village/block selectors plus survey and subdivision number and captcha fields; no form was submitted.

searchQueries.query: Kottayam Kerala official cadastral parcel map GIS land survey resurvey public map
searchQueries.scope: Find a city-specific primary registry source and a safe anonymous geometry-only route.
searchQueries.result: The official Kerala survey-office directory lists the Deputy Director, Assistant Director (Re-Survey), Assistant Director (Mapping), District Survey Superintendent, and District Digitization Centre in Kottayam. The state BhuNaksha portal advertises parcel/map selectors and Plot Info, but its direct HTTPS request failed certificate validation (expired certificate); no bypass was attempted. The public Ente Bhoomi survey search page asks for a survey number, subdivision number, and captcha; no parcel fields were submitted. No safe anonymous full-polygon schema/endpoint was verified.
searchQueries.executionMethod: English-language web search plus direct anonymous inspection of official public routes.
